newsitem.title: USA: DSC sees breakeven Q3 before charge.
newsitem.headline: DSC sees breakeven Q3 before charge.

text.p: DSC Communications Corp said Wednesday earnings for the third quarter are expected to be about breakeven, before a special charge of about $96 million, or $60 million after taxes.
It said it expects to take the charge due to the redirection of certain technology product initiatives.
First Call had estimated earnings of $0.25 per share for the quarter. The company reported earnings of $0.42 for the same period last year.
The company said it expects total revenue between $325 and $335 million for the third quarter, which is below estimates.
